setup: Two mixed quantities in a word problem are compared.

steps.say: The first quantity is [[w1]] whole units and [[a]]/[[b]], and the second is [[w2]] whole units and [[c]]/[[d]].
The whole parts settle most comparisons, because a larger whole unit makes a larger quantity.
When the whole parts match the fractional parts decide, and cross multiplication compares them exactly.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
